answer.reason: Lod (Lydda) is the place where Peter healed Aeneas and the inhabitants turned to the Lord, an event of the story that belongs to it.

clauses.english: was where Peter healed Aeneas, who had been sick of the palsy eight years
clauses.quote: Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed.

clauses.english: saw all its people turn to the Lord after the healing
clauses.quote: all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord

doubts: Lod is called Lydda in ACT; the verse ACT 9:32 and 9:35 name it, 9:33-34 are context taken as the same event.
1CH 8:12 (built by Shamed), EZR 2:33, NEH 7:37 and NEH 11:35 only list or name it; left out.
